summary: Iteration 7 (P2 round): validated intel-feed pagination + facets + date filter + search, admin Leads status PATCH + CSV export, honeypot anti-spam, and process_tree on all 7 curated threats. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (added 7 new tests: intel_feed_pagination/type/since+q, all_threats_have_process_tree, leads_patch_requires_auth, leads_patch_invalid_status, leads_patch_valid_status, lead_honeypot). Frontend: intel-type-facets (all/Ransomware/... 8 chips) filters cards (9->7 for Ransomware); intel-date-filter (90/365/all) refetches; intel-load-more appends (9->18); intel-search debounce filters (ransom => 6 cards); intel-card-0 opens intel-reader-dialog. Admin: tab-leads shows lead-row-N; lead-status-0 dropdown PATCHes to qualified and PERSISTS after full page reload; export-csv triggers download (nivx-leads-2026-07-08.csv) and button is disabled when 0 leads; delete-dialog opens for threat CRUD regression. Landing regression: featured-brief + threat-card detail dialogs render process trees. Honeypot: hidden input has tabIndex=-1, aria-hidden=true, positioned at x=-9247 (off-screen); backend confirms honeypot payload does not persist a real lead (verified via /api/leads listing).

issues: Radix a11y console error: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' + missing Description/aria-describedby when opening intel-reader-dialog. Non-blocking (functionally works) but should be fixed by wrapping DialogTitle with VisuallyHidden and adding DialogDescription.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if needed) and DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the IntelReader Dialog to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: create_lead honeypot branch returns Lead(name=payload.name, email='honeypot@blocked.local') — this synthesized Lead is not persisted (good) but it may confuse clients since the response looks like a normal 200. Consider returning a neutral response (still 200, but without a Lead-shaped body) or logging with client IP for detection. Current UX-only impact is acceptable.
_lead_rate is in-memory per-process; behind multiple workers/replicas the 3/10min limit becomes per-worker. Fine for MVP; document or move to a shared store (redis/mongo TTL) if scaled.
Admin exportLeadsCsv does not sanitize leading `=/+/-/@` (CSV injection). Low risk since admin-only, but worth prefixing dangerous fields with a single quote.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 UI_TEST lead directly into Mongo to bypass 429 rate limit for admin UI testing; cleaned up after (0 test leads remain). Backend pytest also creates + cleans TEST_ leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids verified: intel-type-facets, facet-<type> (facet-all, facet-Ransomware...), intel-date-filter, intel-load-more, lead-status-N, export-csv. Backend paginated /api/intel-feed returns total ~395 (~44 pages of 9). Rate limit for /api/leads is 3 per 10 min per client IP; expect 429 on repeated create. Honeypot 'website' field is off-screen (x=-9999). All 24 pytest cases pass. Only outstanding issue is Radix a11y warning on IntelReader Dialog — non-blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A (all features working). Note: while testing I initially inserted a Mongo lead with a datetime object which broke GET /api/leads (Lead.created_at is str). Reinserted with .isoformat() and it worked. This is a self-inflicted seed error, not a backend bug — the API always writes ISO strings via model_dump.
